content.description:
Join the Future of Supply Chain Intelligence — Powered by Agentic AI

At Resilinc, we’re pioneering intelligent, autonomous systems that redefine supply chain risk management. Our agentic AI helps global enterprises predict disruptions, assess impact, and act in real time — before operations are affected. Named a 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader, we’re trusted by top companies in life sciences & pharma, aerospace & defense, high tech, and automotive to protect what matters most. Be part of a team that's redefining resilience on a global scale.

But the real power behind Resilinc? Our people. We’re a fully remote, mission-led team making sure life-saving products and critical goods get where they’re needed, fast. We offer the chance to do meaningful work in a collaborative, empowering culture—where you can be an agent of change. Join us to tackle critical global challenges through high-impact work that matters.

Check out this blog to learn more about how we are impacting the world's most critical supply chains. Global Supply Chain Risks 2026: Act Faster | TEC

Resilinc | Innovation with Purpose. Intelligence with Impact.

Resilinc is seeking a hands-on Lead Deployment and Support Engineer to establish repeatable deployment practices and provide ongoing technical support for aerospace, defense, and public-sector customers. You will lead technical mobilization, configuration, and data loading; own deployment of approved product features and releases into Resilinc's FedRAMP environment operated by Knox Systems; and resolve customer and system-integrator support needs. You will coordinate with Knox Systems on environment readiness and operating procedures and with the engineering team in India on release packages, deployment instructions, and defect resolution.
Our Mission
At Resilinc, we believe a resilient supply chain is good for everyone: it keeps product flowing, the world moving, and people in their jobs. Our supply chain risk management services help organizations gain visibility into disruption and act quickly to minimize its impact.
Our Culture
We are a customer-centered, cross-functional team that pairs practical problem-solving with continuous learning. We work closely across customer delivery, Product, Engineering, Data, and Supplier Success to make complex supply chain challenges understandable and actionable. We welcome different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and expect every teammate to work with care, accountability, and respect.
What You'll Do
Lead customer deployment planning and scope

Lead technical mobilization for assigned aerospace, defense, and public-sector implementations, partnering with the Technical Project Manager on kickoff materials, technical workplans, readiness gates, dependency tracking, and escalation paths.

Partner with customer program, security, data, integration, and acceptance owners to confirm the initial program scope, BOM and supplier populations, success criteria, decision rights, data-sharing permissions, and acceptance authority.

Assess environment, access, identity, security, data, and integration readiness; surface risks early and convert ambiguous requirements into an executable implementation baseline.

Define practical customer deployment approaches for regulated environments, including approved access patterns, auditability, change controls, configuration promotion, validation, support readiness, and operational handoff.

Own configuration and ongoing technical support

Configure approved customer environments, users, roles, workflows, intake paths, and operating controls in partnership with implementation, engineering, and customer technical teams.

Build and maintain repeatable customer deployment practices, including environment configuration, controlled change promotion, validation checklists, issue tracking, and documented rollback procedures.

Coordinate secure connectivity and approved exchange patterns for customer systems, including APIs, SFTP, structured files, cloud storage, data platforms, ERP, PLM, and other enterprise sources.

Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, access, data, and product issues throughout implementation and ongoing operation; own case documentation, severity assessment, stakeholder updates, escalation, and follow-through through resolution and customer confirmation.

Deploy product features in the FedRAMP environment

Own hands-on deployment of approved Resilinc product features, updates, and fixes into the FedRAMP environment operated by Knox Systems, including application configuration, release execution, post-deployment checks, and operational handoff.

Coordinate with the engineering team in India on release packages, deployment instructions, dependencies, compatibility, and release defects; work with Knox Systems on environment readiness, approved access, and change-control requirements.

Plan deployment windows with Knox Systems and the engineering team in India, validate readiness and rollback steps, perform smoke and regression checks, and maintain release records and validation evidence for the FedRAMP environment.

Monitor product deployments, investigate failures or regressions, and coordinate fixes or rollback with Engineering, Security, and Knox Systems until application behavior and environment health are confirmed.

Support data integration and initial loading

Define data schemas, source-to-target mappings, identifiers, transformation rules, data-quality controls, and reconciliation criteria for supplier, site, part, product/BOM, relationship, material, and risk data.

Support approved ingestion and file or API-based exchange workflows that load representative data, validate completeness and lineage, and capture actionable exceptions for the customer and technical owners.

Lead representative data loads and initial supplier-wave planning, including intake design, sub-tier mapping, exception routing, and readiness reporting.

Use SQL, Python, and approved tools to investigate data issues, validate mappings, automate repeatable checks, and provide clear evidence to customers and internal escalation partners.

Coordinate implementation support and escalation ownership

Work across Engineering, Product, Data, Technical Project Managers, FDEs, Supplier Success, Technical Support, and customer delivery to resolve technical dependencies and drive escalations to closure; provide technical delivery estimates and readiness evidence to the TPM.

Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, data dictionaries, release and implementation records, and handoffs that support pilot, UAT, go-live, and continuing operations.

Identify recurring deployment and support patterns and recommend improvements to implementation procedures, troubleshooting resources, data quality, and customer enablement.

Provide ongoing support for standard product workflows, including EventWatch, DFI data loads, normalization, risk scoring, user configuration, and related tickets and bugs.

Support customers and system integrators with cloud and FedRAMP deployment questions, approved offer capabilities, configuration, and operating procedures; route product or architecture gaps to the appropriate owners.

Use approved AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, to improve delivery operations, documentation, data-quality analysis, and communication speed while following Resilinc data-handling and security practices.
What You'll Bring
Core Qualifications

8+ years of experience in technical deployment, implementation engineering, platform or application support, solutions engineering, or a related customer-facing technical role.

Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or cloud applications through customer deployment, readiness assessment, configuration, controlled product releases, go-live, and ongoing production support.

Working experience with SQL and Python for troubleshooting, data validation, source-to-target mapping, repeatable checks, and reconciliation of structured enterprise data.

Working knowledge of identity and access management, API or file-based data exchange, environment configuration, logging, monitoring, issue management, and customer-support practices.

Hands-on experience deploying application features and releases, validating production changes, troubleshooting release failures, and maintaining deployment and rollback runbooks in controlled environments.

Ability to translate customer needs into practical technical plans, explain findings to business and technical audiences, and maintain precise implementation documentation.

Demonstrated ability to work across security, engineering, product, data, implementation, and customer delivery stakeholders, including coordination with engineering teams in India or other distributed delivery teams.

United States citizenship is required.

Fluency using ChatGPT and Claude, or comparable approved AI-assistance tools, to improve operational efficiency, reporting quality, and communication speed without compromising data security.

Additional Requirements

An active or eligible Secret security clearance is preferred.

This is a remote U.S.-based role with limited travel expected to remain below 20%.
What Will Make You Stand Out?
Experience delivering in federal, government-cloud, FedRAMP, or similarly regulated customer environments.

Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, cloud data warehouses, data-lakehouse patterns, containerized workloads, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

Experience working with aerospace and defense supply-chain data, BOMs, supplier data, PLM, ERP, material traceability, or risk-management workflows.

A record of establishing repeatable, supportable customer deployment practices that improve troubleshooting, escalation quality, and implementation readiness.
What's in it for you?
A technical leadership role that owns product deployment and ongoing support for consequential aerospace, defense, and public-sector programs.

Daily collaboration with customer and internal experts across implementation, technical support, security, supply chain, data, and customer delivery.

The opportunity to shape scalable deployment and support practices for Resilinc's regulated-environment implementations.
What's in it for you?

At Resilinc, we’re fully remote, with plenty of opportunities to connect in person. We provide a culture where ownership, purpose, technical growth and a voice in shaping impactful technology are at our core. Oh, and the perks? Full-stack benefits for health, wealth and wellbeing to keep you thriving. Check in with your talent acquisition contact for a location-specific FAQ.

Curious to know more about us? Dive in at www.resilinc.ai

More great news! Resilinc is backed by Vista Equity Partners
